ui.lib.arcade.aiNoMove: Ikhompyutha ayinantshukumo esemthethweni — lithuba lakho ngoku.
ui.lib.arcade.noHint: Akusekho ntshukumo iluncedo. Tsala ikhadi, yaba umqolo omtsha okanye uqale kwakhona.
ui.lib.arcade.note.2048: Sebenzisa amaqhosha otolo okanye utyibilikise ukuze uhambise zonke iithayile. Iithayile ezimbini ezinenani elifanayo ziyadibana xa zichukumisana. Yenza ithayile elingana nonjongo ukuze udlule inqanaba; ukuba akukho thayile inokushukuma, uyoyiswa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.blocks: Jikelezisa uze ubeke iziqwenga eziwayo ukuze ugcwalise imigca ethe tyaba; imigca egcweleyo iyanyamalala. ← → shukumisa, ↑ jikelezisa, ↓ hlisa ngokukhawuleza, Isithuba siwisa ngoko nangoko, P nqumama. Cima inani lemigca elifunekayo ukuze udlule inqanaba; ukuba iziqwenga zifika phezulu, uyoyiswa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.breakout: Shukumisa imawusi, rhuqa umnwe ebaleni okanye usebenzise ← → ukuqhuba ipedi ugcine ibhola lisemdlalweni. Qhekeza zonke izitena ukuze udlule inqanaba; izitena ezinomda oshinyeneyo zifuna ukubethwa kabini. Unobomi obu-3. Isithuba siyaqalisa okanye sinqumamise.
ui.lib.arcade.note.connect4: Udlala ngobomvu kwaye uqala kuqala. Cofa ikholamu ukuze uwise idiski; iwela kwindawo engenanto esezantsi kakhulu. Owokuqala ukulungelelanisa iidiski ezi-4 ngokuthe tyaba, ngokuthe nkqo okanye ngokudayagonali uyaphumelela.
ui.lib.arcade.note.freecell: Onke amakhadi avuliwe. Hambisa onke amakhadi angama-52 kwiziseko ezi-4 ngohlobo, ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-K. Etafileni, yakha usihla ngemibala etshintshanayo. Iiseli ezingenanto phezulu ekhohlo nganye ibamba ikhadi elinye; mangaphi amakhadi onokuwahambisa kanye ngexesha kuxhomekeke kwiiseli ezingenanto neekholamu ezingenanto. Amanqanaba aphezulu aneeseli ezimbalwa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.gomoku: Udlala ngo-X kwaye uqala kuqala; ikhompyutha idlala ngo-O. Nitshintshana nibeka uphawu kwindawo engenanto yebhodi eyi-15×15. Owokuqala ukufumana ezi-5 ngokulandelelana ngokuthe tyaba, ngokuthe nkqo okanye ngokudayagonali uyaphumelela.
ui.lib.arcade.note.klondike: Hambisa onke amakhadi angama-52 kwiziseko ezi-4 ngohlobo, ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-K. Etafileni, yakha usihla ngemibala etshintshanayo; ngu-K kuphela onokungena kwikholamu engenanto. Cofa imfumba ejonge ezantsi phezulu ekhohlo ukuze utsale amakhadi. Cofa ikhadi uze ucofe indawo ofuna liye kuyo, okanye ulicofe kwakhona ukuze lizihambele kwindawo esemthethweni. Amanqanaba 1–5: tsala elinye; amanqanaba 6–10: tsala amathathu.
ui.lib.arcade.note.match3: Tshintsha iziqwenga ezimbini ezingabamelwane (cofa esinye uze ucofe esinye, okanye utyibilikise) ukuze wenze umgca wezi-3 nangaphezulu ezifanayo; umgca uyaqhuma ze iziqwenga ezingaphezulu ziwe. Iimpendulo ezilandelelanayo ziphindaphinda amanqaku akho. Fikelela amanqaku ekujoliswe kuwo ngaphambi kokuba iintshukumo ziphele.
ui.lib.arcade.note.minesweeper: Cofa iseli ukuze uyivule. Inani libonisa ukuba mingaphi imigodi kwiiseli ezi-8 ezijikelezileyo. Phawula umgodi okrokrelwayo ngokucofa ngasekunene, ukucinezela ixesha elide okanye imowudi yeflegi. Cofa inani esele lineeflegi ezaneleyo ecaleni kwalo ukuze uvule ezinye ngokukhawuleza. Vula zonke iiseli ezingenamgodi ukuze uphumelele.
ui.lib.arcade.note.reversi: Udlala ngomnyama kwaye uqala kuqala. Beka idiski ukuze ibambe idiski emhlophe enye okanye ngaphezulu phakathi kwayo nenye idiski emnyama (ngokuthe tyaba, ngokuthe nkqo okanye ngokudayagonali); iidiski ezibanjiweyo ziguqukela kumbala wakho. Ukuba akunantshukumo esemthethweni, uyaludlula ithuba. Xa ibhodi igcwele, oneediski ezininzi uyaphumelela.
ui.lib.arcade.note.snake: Qhuba inyoka ngamaqhosha otolo, i-WASD, amaqhosha angezantsi okanye ngokutyibilikisa. Tya ukutya okubomvu ukuze ukhule; fikelela ubude obufunekayo ukuze udlule inqanaba. Ukususela kwinqanaba le-3, ukubetha udonga kuphelisa umdlalo; amanqanaba aphezulu aneziphazamiso. Musa ukubetha umsila wakho.
ui.lib.arcade.note.spider: Etafileni, yakha uhlobo ngalunye lube luthotho ukusuka ku-K usihla ukuya ku-A; uthotho olupheleleyo lwamakhadi ali-13 lususwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Nayiphi na ikhadi inokubekwa phezu kwekhadi eliphezulu ngenqanaba elinye, kodwa luthotho lohlobo olufanayo kuphela oluhamba kunye. Ukuba ubambekile, cofa u-Yaba umqolo omtsha (yonke ikholamu mayibe namakhadi). Amanqanaba 1–3: uhlobo olunye; 4–7: ezimbini; 8–10: ezine.

ui.lib.arcade.hintDraw: Akusekho nxibelelwano. Cofa imfumba ukuze utsale ikhadi.
ui.lib.arcade.note.blackjack: Imali yokudlala kuphela — akukho mali yokwenyani. Uqala ngee-chips ezingama-500; fikelela inani ekujoliswe kulo lee-chips kwinani elivumelekileyo lezandla ukuze uphumelele inqanaba. Sondela ku-21 ngaphezu komhambisi ungadlulanga. Umhambisi utsala de afikelele ku-17. I-blackjack (i-ace nekhadi elixabisa elilishumi) ihlawula ngaphezulu. Phinda kabini: uphinda kabini isitya uze ufumane ikhadi elinye kuphela. Yahlula: iyafumaneka xa amakhadi akho amabini okuqala enexabiso elifanayo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.videopoker: Imali yokudlala kuphela — akukho mali yokwenyani. Khetha isitya esisuka kwi-1–5 yee-chips, cinezela Yabela ukufumana amakhadi amahlanu, cofa amakhadi ofuna ukuwagcina, uze ucinezele Tshintsha ukuze utshintshe aseleyo. Isibini samajack okanye ngaphezulu siyahlawula. Uqala nge-100 yee-chips; fikelela inani ekujoliswe kulo lee-chips kwinani elivumelekileyo lezandla ukuze uphumelele inqanaba.
ui.lib.arcade.note.checkers: Udlala ngobomvu (ezantsi) uze uqale. Isiqwenga sihamba isikwere esinye ngokucezu phambili esiya kwisikwere esingenanto. Ukuba unokutsiba phezu kwesiqwenga somchasi, kufuneka utsibe, kwaye unokuqhubeka utsiba ukuthatha iziqwenga ezininzi. Isiqwenga esifikelela kumqolo wokugqibela sibekwa isithsaba sibe yikumkani kwaye sinokuhamba size sithathe nasemva. Uyadilika xa ungasenazo iziqwenga okanye uhambo olusemthethweni.
ui.lib.arcade.ckMust: Kufuneka uthathe xa unako — khetha esinye seziqwenga ezikhazimlayo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.oanquan: Ngumdlalo wemveli waseVietnam. Umqolo osezantsi ngowakho, osemva ngowekhompyutha, kwaye iziphelo ezimbini ziziqwenga zeMandarin. Cofa esinye seziqwenga zakho, uze ukhethe icala: onke amatye akulo athathwa aze atyalwe linye kwisikwere ngasinye. Emva kokutyala, ukuba isikwere elandelayo sinamatye, wathathe uqhubeke utyala; ukuba isikwere elandelayo asinanto nesilandelayo sinamatye okanye iMandarin, usithatha (kwaye uqhubeka uthatha ukuba emva kwesinye isikwere esingenanto kulandela esinamatye). Yima kwisikwere seMandarin okanye emva kweziqwenga ezimbini ezingenanto ngokulandelelana. IMandarin ixabisa amanqaku ali-10, ilitye li-1. Ukuba icala lakho liphelelwa ngamatye, amanqaku ama-5 owawathathileyo ayatyalwa kwakhona. Umdlalo uphela xa zombini iiMandarin zithathiwe; oneenqaku ezininzi uyaphumelela.
ui.lib.arcade.note.ludo: Udlala ngobomvu; ezinye iimibala zidlalwa yikhompyutha. Phosa idayisi: ufuna u-6 ukukhupha isiqwenga ekhayeni, kwaye u-6 ukunika okunye ukuphosa (ii-6 ezintathu ngokulandelelana zikulahlisa umjikelo). Iziqwenga zihamba ngeyure ejikeleze ibhodi, emva koko zijike zingene kwindlela yekhaya yombala wazo; ufuna inani elichanekileyo ukufikelela esiphelweni embindini. Ukuba uwela ngqo phezu kwesiqwenga somchasi, siphindela ekhayeni lasiko (ngaphandle kweziqwenga zenkwenkwezi neziqwenga zokuqala). Owokuqala ukufaka zonke ezi-4 iziqwenga ekhayeni uyaphumelela.
ui.lib.arcade.ldWin: Zonke ezi-4 iziqwenga zakho zifikile ekhayeni!
ui.lib.arcade.note.pyramid: Susa onke amakhadi angama-28 epiramidi. Cofa amakhadi amabini akhululekileyo (angagqunyelwanga ngelinye ikhadi) adibana abe ngu-13 (A=1, J=11, Q=12) ukuze asuswe omabini; iKumkani isuswa yodwa ngokucofa kanye. Ikhadi eliphezulu lemfumba yelahliweyo nalo linokusetyenziswa. Cofa imfumba ukutsala; amaxesha onokuphinda ulusebenzise ngawo imfumba yelahliweyo alinganiselwe.
ui.lib.arcade.note.tripeaks: Susa onke amakhadi angama-28 eencopho ezintathu. Cofa ikhadi elikhululekileyo elingaphezulu okanye elingaphantsi ngomgangatho omnye kuphela kunekhadi elibonakalayo kwimfumba yelahliweyo (nasiphi na isimbo) ukuze lihle. Xa ungasenazo iintshukumo, cofa imfumba ukutsala. Kumanqanaba alula, i-K idibana ne-A.
ui.lib.arcade.note.golf: Susa zonke iikholam. Ikhadi elisezantsi kuphela kwikholam nganye lingacofwa: kufuneka libe ngaphezulu okanye ngaphantsi ngomgangatho omnye kuphela kunekhadi elibonakalayo. Xa ungasenazo iintshukumo, cofa imfumba ukutsala. Kumanqanaba alula, i-K idibana ne-A.
ui.lib.arcade.note.nonogram: Amanani ekuqaleni komqolo ngamnye nekholam nganye abonisa ubude beqela lamabhokisi agcwalisiweyo alandelelanayo kuloo mgca, ngokulandelelana, kunebhokisi enye engenanto ubuncinane phakathi kwamaqela. Cofa okanye tsala ukugcwalisa amabhokisi; tshintshela kwi-“Phawula ✕” ukuphawula amabhokisi oqinisekileyo ukuba angenanto. Fezekisa zonke izikhokelo ukuze uphumelele.
ui.lib.arcade.note.sokoban: Hambisa umdlali ngamaqhosha omnqwazi/WASD, amaqhosha asezantsi okanye ngokutshiza. Sunduzela onke amabhokisi kwiindawo ekujoliswe kuzo (amachaphaza angqukuva). Unokusunduzela ibhokisi enye ngexesha elinye kwaye awunakutsala, ngoko phepha ukusunduzela amabhokisi emakoneni. Sebenzisa Rhoxisa ukulungisa inyathelo elibi.
ui.lib.arcade.note.block10: Khetha isiqwenga ezantsi, emva koko ucofe igridi ukuze usibeke (iziqwenga azijikelezi). Zalisa umqolo okanye ikholam yonke ukuyicima kwaye ufumane amanqaku ongezelelweyo; ukucima imigca emininzi ngaxeshanye kunika imbasa enkulu. Fikelela kumanqaku ekujoliswe kuwo ukuze uphumelele inqanaba; ukuba akukho siqwenga sisele esifaneleyo, uyoyiswa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.dots: Landelelanani nidibanise amachaphaza amabini angabamelwane ngomgca. Lowo uzobe icala lesine lesikwere uyasithatha (ngombala wakhe) kwaye udlala kwakhona. Yonke imigca ikuba izotyiwe, umdlali onezikwere ezininzi uyaphumelela. Phepha ukuzoba icala lesithathu lesikwere, kungenjalo umchasi wakho uya kusithatha.
ui.lib.arcade.note.ultimate: Ibhodi yenziwe ngeebhodi ezincinci ezi-9 ze-tic-tac-toe. Wena udlala u-X kwaye uqala. Ibhokisi oyikhethayo ngaphakathi kwebhodi encinci ibona ukuba ngowuphi umdlalo omncinci umchasi wakho kufuneka adlale kuwo emva koko (uqaqambisiwe); ukuba loo bhodi sele iphelile, angadlala naphi na. Phumelela ibhodi encinci ukuze uyithathe; thatha iibhodi ezincinci ezintathu kumqolo, kwikholam okanye kwidayagonali ukuze uphumelele umdlalo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.lights-out: Ukucofa ibhokisi kutshintsha loo bhokisi kunye nabamelwane bayo abane (vula/cima). Cima zonke izibane. Sebenzisa Isiluleko ukubona ibhokisi efanele ukucofwa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.fifteen: Shushumbisa iithayile ezinamanani zisingise kwisikhewu uzilungiselele 1, 2, 3… isikhewu sisekoneni esezantsi ngasekunene. Cofa ithayile esemqolweni okanye kwikholam enye nesikhewu ukushushumbisa umgca wonke; amaqhosha omnqwazi nawo ayasebenza.
ui.lib.arcade.note.flood-it: Khetha umbala wokugcwalisa lonke indawo oyilawulayo ekoneni ephezulu ngasekhohlo; iginya amabhokisi angabamelwane ombala omnye. Yenza ibhodi yonke ibe ngumbala omnye ngaphakathi kwenani eliyivumelekileyo lamanyathelo.
ui.lib.arcade.note.mastermind: Ikhompyuter ifihla umqolo wemibala. Khetha umbala kwindawo nganye, emva koko ucinezele Ukiqiqa. Isikhonkwane esimnyama = umbala ochanekileyo kwindawo echanekileyo; isikhonkwane esimhlophe = umbala ochanekileyo kwindawo engachanekanga. Qhekeza ikhowudi ngaphambi kokuba iziqikelelo ziphele.
ui.lib.arcade.note.hanoi: Hambisa onke amadiski ukuya kwisigxina sokugqibela. Hambisa kuphela idiski ephezulu yesigxina ngasinye ngexesha, kwaye ungaze ubeke idiski enkulu phezu kwencinci. Cofa isigxina somthombo, emva koko isigxina ekujoliswe kuso.
ui.lib.arcade.note.pipes: Cofa ithayile ukujikelezisa umbhobho nge-90°. Dibanisa yonke imibhobho ibe yinethiwekhi enye engenamacala avulekileyo (amacala avulekileyo abonakala ngombala obomvu).

image-convert.desc: Nciphisa ubukhulu befayile yomfanekiso kwaye ucinezele imifanekiso emininzi ngexesha elinye ukulayisha ngokukhawuleza kwiwebhu nakwi-imeyile.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF

file-diff.desc: Fumana iyantlukwano phakathi kwemibhalo emibini: TXT, Word, HTML okanye i-PDF esekelwe kumbhalo. Iindawo ezongeziweyo, ezisusiweyo nezitshintshiweyo ziyaqaqanjiswa.

text-analysis.desc: Bala amagama, oonobumba, izivakalisi neentetho, uqikelele ixesha lokufunda kunye nobuninzi bamagama aphambili kumbhalo, kwiifayile ze-TXT, Word okanye PDF.

data-convert.name: Guqula i-JSON, XML, CSV, Excel

bmi-bmr.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha ye-BMI Ne-BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Bala isalathiso sobunzima bomzimba (BMI), umlinganiselo wesiqu-sibuno kunye neekhalori ezifunekayo (BMR, TDEE) ngokweminyaka, isini nenqanaba lomsebenzi.

meal-calo.name: Isicwangciso Sokutya Kwemihla Ngemihla Neekhalori
meal-calo.desc: Cwangcisa ukutya ngokweekhalori ozifunayo, jonga iikhalori zokutya okuqhelekileyo kwaye ulinganise iprotheyini, iicarbs kunye namafutha.

water-tracker.name: Umlandeli Wamanzi Aselwayo
water-tracker.desc: Misela injongo yemihla ngemihla kwaye urekhode ukuba usela amanzi amalini, ngenkqubela nembali yemihla emininzi.

calo-burn.name: Iikhalori Ezitshiswe Ngumsebenzi
calo-burn.desc: Qikelela iikhalori ezitshiswe yimidlalo, umsebenzi, ixesha nobunzima bomzimba usebenzisa amaxabiso e-MET.

cycle-track.name: Umlandeli Womjikelo Wenyanga
cycle-track.desc: Rekhoda uze uqikelele umjikelo wakho wenyanga, usuku lokukhupha iqanda kunye nemini yokuzala. Idatha ihlala kwisixhobo sakho kuphela.

study-timetable.name: Ishedyuli Yokufunda
study-timetable.desc: Yakha ishedyuli yeeklasi zeveki ngeperiyodi; yiprinte okanye uyigcine ukuze uyisebenzise yonke imihla.

quiz-bank.name: Imibuzo Nebhanki Yemibuzo
quiz-bank.desc: Yenza ibhanki yemibuzo enokhetho oluninzi, xuba imibuzo, thatha uvavanyo lokuziqhelanisa olunamanqaku, uze uprinte uvavanyo neempendulo.

mindmap.name: Imephu Yengqondo Nesishwankathelo
mindmap.desc: Zoba iimephu zengqondo zezifundo kwaye ushwankathele ngokuzenzekelayo umbhalo omde ube ziingongoma eziphambili.

teaching-pay.desc: Rekhoda iiseshoni zokufundisa, ubale iiyure zizonke nentlawulo ngomrhumo, uze ukhuphele ingxelo.

fullscreen-clock.desc: Iwotshi enkulu yedijithali yesikrini esipheleleyo enesitophu-wotshi nokubala ngasemva, imibala, uhlobo lonobumba nefomathi yeeyure ezili-12/24 enokulungiswa.

world-clock.desc: Jonga ixesha langoku kumazwe amaninzi ngaxeshanye kwaye uthelekise ukwahluka kweendawo zexesha phakathi kwawo.

journal.name: Ijenali Ye-Intanethi

js-obfuscate.desc: Bhala imitya ngekhowudi, tshintsha amagama oguquko kwaye ufihle i-JavaScript ukuze ube nzima ukuyifunda nokuyikopa.

text-to-html.desc: Hlela ngokubona ngeqinisa, izihloko, uluhlu, iitafile namakhonkco, uze ufumane ikhowudi ye-HTML ecocekileyo.

image-crop.name: Sika Umfanekiso
image-crop.desc: Sika imifanekiso ngokukhululekileyo okanye ukuya kwi-1:1, 4:3, 16:9 ne-9:16, uze ujikeleze okanye uguqule phambi kokukhuphela.

image-ocr.name: Umfanekiso Uye Kumbhalo (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Khupha umbhalo kwiifoto, ezikrinini neencwadi ezidanyaziweyo. Ixhasa isiNgesi kunye neelwimi ezingaphezu kwama-30.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC Ukuya Kwi-JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Guqula iifoto ze-HEIC ze-iPhone zibe yi-JPG okanye i-PNG ukuze zivule naphi na. Ukuguqula ngokubanzi kuyaxhaswa.

image-upscale.name: Umkhulisi Wemifanekiso We-AI
image-upscale.desc: Khulisa imifanekiso ngo-2× okanye ngo-4× uze ubukhali iinkcukacha nge-AI. Mhle kwiifoto ezincinci, ezingacacanga okanye ezindala.

image-to-pdf.name: Umfanekiso Uye Kwi-PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Dibanisa imifanekiso ye-JPG ne-PNG ibe yi-PDF enye, hlela kwakhona amaphepha uze ukhethe ubungakanani bephepha neemarjini.

pdf-to-image.name: I-PDF Iye Kumfanekiso
pdf-to-image.desc: Guqula iphepha ngalinye le-PDF libe yi-JPG okanye i-PNG ecacileyo, khetha isisombululo, khuphela imifanekiso emnye-mnye okanye i-ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Cinezela I-PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Nciphisa ubungakanani befayile ye-PDF yee-imeyile nefom ze-intanethi. Khetha inqanaba lokucinezela uze uthelekise ubungakanani.

pdf-to-word.name: I-PDF Iye Kwi-Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Guqula i-PDF ibe yifayile ehlelekayo ye-Word (.docx) egcina umbhalo neziqendu, okanye ugcine uyilo lwephepha njengemifanekiso.

word-to-pdf.name: I-Word Iye Kwi-PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Guqula iifayile ze-Word (.docx) zibe yi-PDF kwisikhangeli sakho, jonga kwangaphambili, uze ukhuphele okanye uprinte.

pdf-sign.name: Sayina I-PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Zoba okanye chwetheza ityikitye lakho, yongeza ityikitye lomfanekiso nomhla, libeke emaphepheni e-PDF uze ukhuphele.

pdf-edit.name: Hlela I-PDF Nokuzalisa Iifom
pdf-edit.desc: Yongeza umbhalo, iimpawu zokuqinisekisa neebhokisi zokufihla kwii-PDF uze uzalise iindawo zefom ezikhoyo.

case-convert.name: Umguquli Wobukhulu Boonobumba
case-convert.desc: Guqula umbhalo ube yiOONOBUMBA ABAKHULU, oonobumba abancinci, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case nokunye.

fancy-text.name: Ijeneretha Yombhalo Ohlaziyiweyo
fancy-text.desc: Guqula umbhalo oqhelekileyo ube ngaphezu kweefonti ezili-30 ezintle ze-Instagram, TikTok, ii-bio ze-Facebook namagama emidlalo. Kopa ngokucofa kanye.

text-to-speech.name: Umbhalo Uye Kwintetho
text-to-speech.desc: Funda umbhalo ngokuvakalayo ngamazwi esixhobo sakho. Khetha ilizwi, isantya nokuphakama. Ixhasa iilwimi ezininzi.

speech-to-text.name: Intetho Iye Kumbhalo
speech-to-text.desc: Chwetheza ngelizwi lakho: thetha kwimakrofoni ubone umbhalo uvela ngoko nangoko, uze uwukope okanye uwukhuphele.

scientific-calc.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Yenzululwazi
scientific-calc.desc: Ikhalkyuleyitha ye-intanethi enetrigonometri, ii-logarithm, amandla, iingcambu, i-factorial, iidigri/ii-radian, imemori nembali.

percentage.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Yepesenti
percentage.desc: Fumana i-X% ye-Y, i-X ipesenti ingakanani ye-Y, utshintsho lwepesenti nexabiso lokuthengisa, ngeefomula zamanyathelo ngamanyathelo.

unit-convert.name: Umguquli Weeyunithi
unit-convert.desc: Guqula ubude, ubunzima, ubushushu, indawo, umthamo, isantya, ixesha, idatha, uxinzelelo namandla.

age-calc.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Yeminyaka
age-calc.desc: Bala iminyaka echanekileyo ngeminyaka, iinyanga neentsuku, iintsuku zizonke ozihlalileyo, usuku lokuzalwa olulandelayo nophawu lwenkwenkwezi.

date-calc.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Yemihla
date-calc.desc: Bala iintsuku phakathi kwemihla emibini, yongeza okanye susa iintsuku, iiveki, iinyanga neminyaka, uze ubone usuku lweveki.

gpa.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Ye-GPA
gpa.desc: Bala i-GPA yesemesta nenqabileyo ngeekredithi kwisikali se-4.0 ngamanqaku oonobumba.

due-date.name: Ikhalkyuleyitha Yosuku Lokuzalwa Komntwana
due-date.desc: Qikelela umhla wokubeleka kunye neveki yokukhulelwa ukusuka kwixesha lokugqibela lenyanga, umhla wokukhulelwa okanye i-ultrasound, ngeendawo eziphambili.

spin-wheel.name: Jikelezisa Ivili
spin-wheel.desc: Yenza ivili ngawo nawaphi na amagama okanye amabhaso, jikelezisa ngokungakhethiyo ngokufanelekileyo, susa abaphumeleleyo, imo yesikrini esipheleleyo.

random-number.name: Ijeneretha Yamanani Angacwangciswanga
random-number.desc: Yenza amanani angacwangciswanga kuluhlu oluthile, amaninzi ngexesha elinye, nokanye ngaphandle kokuphindaphinda, kwimidlalo nokuthatha-ntweni.

typing-test.name: Uvavanyo Lwesantya Sokuchwetheza
typing-test.desc: Linganisa isantya sakho sokuchwetheza (WPM) nokuchaneka kwimizuzwana engama-30 ukuya kwimizuzu emi-5.

cps-test.name: Uvavanyo Lwe-CPS (Isantya Sokucofa)
cps-test.desc: Bala ukucofa ngomzuzwana kwimizuzwana eyi-1 ukuya kwengama-60, gcina amanqaku akho amakhulu, uvavanye nespacebar nokuchukumisa.

webcam-test.name: Uvavanyo Lwekhamera Yewebhu
webcam-test.desc: Khangela ukuba ikhamera yakho iyasebenza, ubone isisombululo nenqanaba lamafreyimu, tshintsha amakhamera uze uthathe ifoto yovavanyo.

screen-recorder.name: Umrekhodi Wesikrini
screen-recorder.desc: Rekhoda isikrini sakho, ifestile okanye ithebhu ngesandi sesistim nemakrofoni, akukho kufakela kufunekayo.

video-compress.name: Umcinezeli Wevidiyo
video-compress.desc: Nciphisa iifayile ze-MP4, MOV ne-WebM zemiyalezo, ii-imeyile nemidiya yoluntu. Khetha isisombululo nomgangatho.

video-to-mp3.name: Ividiyo Iye Kwi-MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Khupha isandi kwiividiyo ze-MP4, MOV ne-WebM njenge-MP3, khetha umgangatho uze unqumle icandelo olifunayo.

guitar-tuner.name: Umvumelanisi Wesiginci
guitar-tuner.desc: Vumelanisa isiginci, i-ukulele nebhesi ngemakrofoni yakho: inoti, ukwahluka kwee-cents nenaliti, kunye neetoni zebhekiselo.

password-gen.name: Ijeneretha Yamagama Aphambili
password-gen.desc: Yenza amagama aphambili anamandla angacwangciswanga okanye amabinzana okukhumbula, khetha ubude noonobumba, ukhangele amandla.

signature.name: Umenzi Wamatyikitye
signature.desc: Zoba ityikitye lakho ngempuku okanye ngomnwe, okanye uchwethe ngeefonti zesandla; khuphela i-PNG ecacileyo.

logo-maker.name: Umenzi Welogo
logo-maker.desc: Yenza ilogo ngeicon, igama lebrendi nesiqubulo; khetha iifonti, imibala noyilo, ukhuphele i-SVG okanye i-PNG.

notepad.name: Incwadana Yamanqaku Ye-Intanethi
notepad.desc: Amanqaku ahlala egcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwisikhangeli sakho: amanqaku amaninzi, ukukhangela, ukubala amagama nokukhuphela i-TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Zalisa iWord ngeExcel
excel-word-fill.desc: Thatha umxholo kwifayile yeExcel uwufake kwiimpawu zefayile yeWord, kunye neentloko ezinamanani zibonakaliswa ngebala elibomvu.

excel-cell-merge.name: Hlanganisa Amaseli eExcel Kumashiti / Iifayile Ezininzi
excel-cell-merge.desc: Hlanganisa iseli enye (A1, B2...) evela kumashiti okanye iifayile zeExcel ezininzi ibe yinye, kunye nesilumkiso samaseli anedatha kumthombo ongaphezu koyedwa.

excel-row-concat.name: Dibanisa Imiqolo yeExcel Evela Kumashiti / Iifayile Ezininzi
excel-row-concat.desc: Dibanisa amashiti okanye iifayile zeExcel ezininzi ngokuma nkqo zibe yitafile enye ende. Gcina isihloko kanye uze ususe imiqolo engenanto.

excel-formula-merge.name: Dibanisa iDatha yeExcel ngeeFomyula
excel-formula-merge.desc: Dibanisa amashiti okanye iifayile zeExcel ezininzi ngefomyula kwiseli nganye (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), imisebenzi engaphakathi komnye, neefomyula ezigciniweyo onokuzisebenzisa kwakhona.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Dlala i-Sudoku 9x9 kwi-intanethi kumanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima, ngamanqaku, izalathiso nokukhangela iimpazamo.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: I-Sudoku enkulu 16x16 esebenzisa i-1-9 ne-A-G, amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima, ngamanqaku nezalathiso.

chess.name: I-chess
chess.desc: Dlala i-chess nekhompyutha kumanqanaba ali-10 okanye kwi-intanethi: mema umhlobo ngekhonkco okanye udlale nomntu omtsha. Ine-castling, en passant nokunyuselwa.

xiangqi.name: I-Xiangqi (i-chess yaseTshayina)
xiangqi.desc: Dlala i-Xiangqi nekhompyutha kumanqanaba ali-10 okanye kwi-intanethi: mema umhlobo ngekhonkco okanye udlale nomntu omtsha. Imithetho epheleleyo: umlenze wehashe, iliso lendlovu, ukutsiba kwenkanunu noonjengele abangavumelekanga ukubonana.

go-game.name: I-Go
go-game.desc: Dlala i-Go nekhompyutha kumanqanaba ali-10 okanye kwi-intanethi kwiibhodi ze-9x9, 13x13 ne-19x19 nomhlobo okanye umchasi omtsha. Ukubala okuzenzekelayo ekugqibeleni.

memory-shapes.name: Inkumbulo yoMbumbo noMbala
memory-shapes.desc: Iitayile ezinemibumbo neebala zibonakaliswa imizuzwana emi-5, emva koko zifihlwe; khumbula ukhethe itayile echanekileyo, amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

web-desktop.name: Idesktop ekwi-intanethi
web-desktop.desc: Idesktop yekhompyutha kwisiphequluli sakho: umphathi weefayile, Notepad, isibonisi semifanekiso nesePDF, isixhobo sokubala, ikhalenda nomgqomo. Iifayile zigcinwa kwiGoogle Drive yakho.

co-up.name: I-Xiangqi efihliweyo
co-up.desc: Dlala i-Xiangqi efihliweyo yaseVietnam: amaqhekeza aqala ejonge ezantsi kwaye ajikwa emva kwentshukumo yokuqala. Nekhompyutha kumanqanaba ali-10 okanye kwi-intanethi nabahlobo nabachasi abatsha.

game-2048.desc: Tyibilikisa uze udibanise amanani afanayo de ube nethayile eyi-2048; amanqanaba ali-10 aneenjongo ukusuka kwi-64 ukuya kwi-8192, nokurhoxisa.

minesweeper.name: Umkhangeli wemigodi
minesweeper.desc: Umkhangeli wemigodi weklasikhi: vula iiseli, beka iiflegi uze ufumane kumanani ukuba iphi imigodi; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kwi-8x8 ukuya kwi-18x18, isebenza nakwifowuni.

block-puzzle.name: Iibhloko eziwayo
block-puzzle.desc: Jikelezisa uze upakishe iibhloko eziwayo ukuze ucime imigca; amanqanaba ali-10 akhawulezayo ngakumbi, ngebhodi yezitshixo okanye amaqhosha okuchukumisa.

snake.name: Inyoka
snake.desc: Qhuba inyoka ukuze itye ikhule ngaphandle kokubetha iindonga okanye umsila wayo; amanqanaba ali-10 akhawulezayo aneziphazamiso.

solitaire.name: I-Solitaire
solitaire.desc: I-Klondike Solitaire yeklasikhi: yakha usihla ngemibala etshintshanayo uze uhambise amakhadi kwiziseko ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-K; tsala elinye okanye amathathu, nokurhoxisa namacebiso.

spider-solitaire.name: I-Solitaire yesigcawu
spider-solitaire.desc: Isigcawu esineentlobo ezi-1, ezi-2 nezi-4: yakha uthotho lohlobo olufanayo ukusuka ku-K ukuya ku-A ukuze uzisuse etafileni; amanqanaba ali-10 anokurhoxisa namacebiso.

freecell.name: FreeCell
freecell.desc: I-FreeCell Solitaire: onke amakhadi avuliwe; sebenzisa iiseli ezingenanto ukuhambisa amakhadi kwiziseko; amanqanaba ali-10 aneeseli ezincipha.

gomoku.name: I-Gomoku (ezintlanu ngokulandelelana)
gomoku.desc: Dlala i-Gomoku, ezintlanu ngokulandelelana, uchasene nekhompyutha kwibhodi eyi-15x15; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima, nokurhoxisa.

reversi.name: I-Reversi
reversi.desc: Bamba iidiski zomchasi wakho ukuze ziguqukele kumbala wakho; dlala i-Reversi eyi-8x8 uchasene nekhompyutha kumanqanaba ali-10.

connect-four.name: Ezine ngokulandelelana
connect-four.desc: Wisa iidiski kwiikholamu uze ulungelelanise ezi-4 ngokuthe tyaba, ngokuthe nkqo okanye ngokudayagonali phambi kwekhompyutha; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

match-3.name: Dibanisa ezi-3
match-3.desc: Tshintsha iilekese ukuze udibanise ezi-3 nangaphezulu ezifanayo uqalise iimpendulo ezilandelelanayo; amanqanaba ali-10 anamanqaku ekujoliswe kuwo neentshukumo ezilinganiselweyo.

brick-breaker.name: Umqhekezi wezitena
brick-breaker.desc: Qhuba ipedi uze utsibise ibhola ukuze uqhekeze zonke izitena; izigaba ezili-10 ezinoyilo olwahlukileyo, ngemawusi, ngokuchukumisa okanye ngamaqhosha.

pyramid.name: I-Pyramid Solitaire
pyramid.desc: Susa ipiramidi yamakhadi angama-28 ngokudibanisa amakhadi adibana abe ngu-13; amanqanaba ali-10 anokuphinda udibanise okuncinci.

tripeaks.name: I-TriPeaks Solitaire
tripeaks.desc: Susa iincopho ezintathu ngokudibanisa amakhadi ahlukene ngomgangatho omnye; amanqanaba ali-10 asuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

golf.name: I-Golf Solitaire
golf.desc: Susa iikholam ngokudibanisa amakhadi ahlukene ngomgangatho omnye nekhadi elibonakalayo; amanqanaba ali-10 anamakholam amaninzi njengoko uqhubeka.

blackjack.name: I-Blackjack
blackjack.desc: Dlala i-blackjack ngokuchasene nomhambisi ngee-chips ezingeyonyani: sondela ku-21 ungadlulanga; phinda kabini uze wahlule; amanqanaba ali-10 anokujoliswe kuko okukhulayo.

video-poker.name: I-Video Poker
video-poker.desc: I-poker yamakhadi amahlanu ngee-chips ezingeyonyani (amajack okanye ngaphezulu); amanqanaba ali-10 anethebhile yeentlawulo esiya isomelela.

checkers.name: I-Draughts
checkers.desc: Dlala i-draughts ye-8x8 ngokuchasene nekhompyutha: ukuthatha okunyanzelekileyo, ukutsiba okuninzi neekumkani; amanqanaba ali-10 asuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

ludo.name: I-Ludo
ludo.desc: Umdlalo wokubaleka onemibala emine: phosa idayisi uze ufake ezi-4 iziqwenga zakho ekhayeni kuqala; dlala ngokuchasene nabadlali bekhompyutha abangu-1 ukuya kwabangu-3 kumanqanaba ali-10.

o-an-quan.name: I-Ô ăn quan
o-an-quan.desc: Umdlalo wemveli waseVietnam wokutyala amatye: tyala amatye uthathe iiMandarin ngokuchasene nekhompyutha; amanqanaba ali-10 asuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

lights-out.name: Lights Out
lights-out.desc: Cima zonke izibane: ukucinezela ngalinye kutshintsha ibhokisi kunye nabamelwane bayo abane; amanqanaba ali-10 anamabhodi akhulayo kunye neqhosha lesiluleko.

fifteen.name: Ipuzzle ye-15 (ipuzzle eshushumbayo)
fifteen.desc: Shushumbisa iithayile ezinamanani ukuze zilandelelane; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kwi-3x3 ukuya kwi-5x5, kudlalwa ngemawusi, ukcofa okanye amaqhosha omnqwazi.

flood-it.name: Flood-it
flood-it.desc: Zalisa ibhodi ukusuka ekoneni de ibe ngumbala omnye ngaphakathi kwenani elilinganiselweyo lamanyathelo; amanqanaba ali-10 anamabhodi amakhulu kunye nemibala emininzi.

mastermind.name: Mastermind (Umqhekezi wekhowudi)
mastermind.desc: Qhekeza ikhowudi yemibala efihliweyo usebenzisa izikhokelo zezikhonkwane ezimnyama nezimhlophe; amanqanaba ali-10 anezikhowudi ezinde kunye nemibala emininzi.

hanoi.name: Inqaba yaseHanoi
hanoi.desc: Hambisa amadiski usuka kwisigxina sokuqala uye kwesokugqibela ungabeki idiski enkulu phezu kwencinci; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kumadiski ama-3 ukuya kwayi-12 kwizigxina ezi-4.

pipes.name: Dibanisa imibhobho
pipes.desc: Jikelezisa iziqwenga zemibhobho ukuze zidibane zibe yinethiwekhi enye engenamacala avulekileyo; amanqanaba ali-10 anamabhodi akhulayo.

nonogram.name: Nonogram (Picross)
nonogram.desc: Zalisa amabhokisi usebenzisa izikhokelo zamanani kwimiqolo nakwiikholam ukuze utyhile umfanekiso; amanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kwi-5x5 ukuya kwi-15x15.

sokoban.name: Sokoban (Umsundulizi webhokisi)
sokoban.desc: Sunduzela amabhokisi kwiindawo ekujoliswe kuzo egodaunini; onke amanqanaba ayasonjululwa, amanqanaba ali-10 anamabhokisi amaninzi namagodauni amakhulu.

block-10x10.name: Block Puzzle 10x10
block-10x10.desc: Beka iziqwenga kwigridi ye-10x10 uzalise imiqolo okanye iikholam ukuze uzicime ufikelele kumanqaku ekujoliswe kuwo; amanqanaba ali-10.

dots-boxes.name: Amachaphaza namabhokisi
dots-boxes.desc: Landelelanani nidibanise amachaphaza ukuze nithathe izikwere uze woyise ikhompyuter kumanqanaba ali-10 ukusuka kokulula ukuya kokunzima.

ultimate-tictactoe.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Ekhethekileyo
ultimate-tictactoe.desc: I-tic-tac-toe kwiibhodi ezincinci ezi-9: ibhokisi oyikhethayo ibona apho umchasi wakho kufuneka adlale khona; ngokuchasene nekhompyuter kumanqanaba ali-10.

bg-remove.drop.title: Khetha umfanekiso okanye uwuwise apha
bg-remove.drop.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Ilungele iifoto zemveliso kwisiseko esimhlophe okanye sombala omnye. Imifanekiso iqhutyelwa kwisixhobo sakho.
bg-remove.tol.label: Ukuvakalelwa
bg-remove.contiguous: Susa kuphela isiseko esidityaniswe nemiphetho (gcina iinkcukacha zombala ofanayo ngaphakathi kwento)
bg-remove.note.autobg: Umbala wesiseko ufunyaniswa kwimiphetho. Ukuba awuchanekanga, cofa indawo yesiseko kumfanekiso wokuqala ukuze ukhethe kwakhona.
bg-remove.feather.label: Thambisa imiphetho
bg-remove.stage.resultHint: Isiphumo sivela ngoko nangoko ukhetha umfanekiso.
bg-remove.bgcolor.label: Umbala omtsha wesiseko
bg-remove.canvas.title: Cofa indawo yesiseko ukukhetha umbala wayo
bg-remove.ai.dropTitle: Khetha imifanekiso okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
bg-remove.ai.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Imifanekiso emininzi ngexesha elinye, nganye engaphantsi kwe-40 MB. Unokunamathisela nge-Ctrl+V.
bg-remove.ai.mGeneral: Nantoni na (iimveliso, izilwanyana ezifuyiweyo, izinto, abantu)
bg-remove.ai.mGeneralD: ichane kakhulu, ikhuphela imodeli engange-200 MB okokuqala
bg-remove.ai.mPortraitD: ikhawuleza, imodeli elula engange-25 MB, ilungele iifoto ze-ID neefoto zeprofayile
bg-remove.ai.note: I-AI isebenza kwisixhobo sakho (isebenzisa ikhadi lakho lemizobo ukuba isikhangeli sixhasa i-WebGPU); imifanekiso ayithunyelwa naphi na. Imodeli ikhutshelwa kuphela okokuqala yaye igcinwa sisikhangeli sakho. Iikhompyuter okanye iifowuni ezindala zisenokuthatha imizuzwana eyi-10–60 umfanekiso ngamnye. Kwiziseko ezimhlophe ezilula, isixhobo Sokususa Isiseko Somfanekiso siyakhawuleza.
bg-remove.ai.err: Ayikwazanga ukuqhuba i-AI kweli sikhangeli. Zama i-Chrome okanye i-Edge entsha.

attendance.add.label: Yongeza umfundi
attendance.add.ph: Chwetheza igama uze ucinezele i-Enter (enye komgca ngamnye xa unamathisela abaninzi)
attendance.date.label: Umhla wokubakho
attendance.note: Cofa iseli yesimo ukuze utshintshe: Akhona → Akekho → Ufike emva kwexesha → Uxolelwe. Iikholam zesishwankathelo zibala yonke imbali. Ngena nge-Google ukugcina kwi-Google Sheets.
attendance.th.name: Igama
attendance.empty: Akukho bafundi okwangoku. Yongeza amagama kwibhokisi ephezulu (unokunamathisela imigca emininzi).
attendance.cell.title: Cofa ukuze utshintshe

barcode.value.label: Ikhowudi ekufuneka yenziwe
barcode.mw.label: Ububanzi bebha

rsa-keys.pubPh: Cofa "Yenza isibini esitsha sezitshixo" okanye wamathisele isitshixo sikawonke-wonke se-PEM (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----) apha, uze ucofe "Sebenzisa isibini sezitshixo esinamathisiweyo".
rsa-keys.privPh: Isitshixo sangasese se-PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). Esi sitshixo siyafuneka ukuvula.
rsa-keys.status.none: Yenza okanye wamathisele isibini sezitshixo ngasentla. Isitshixo sikawonke-wonke sikuvumela ukufihla; isitshixo sangasese sikuvumela ukuvula.
rsa-keys.plainPh: Chwetheza umbhalo apha; umtya ofihliweyo uvela ekunene.
rsa-keys.cipherPh: Okanye wamathisele umtya ofihliweyo apha ukuze uwuvule ube ngumbhalo.
rsa-keys.note: Yonke into isebenza kwisikhangeli sakho nge-Web Crypto kwaye ayithunyelwa naphi na. Ekubeni i-RSA inokufihla idatha emfutshane kakhulu ngqo, isixhobo sisebenzisa ukufihla okudibeneyo: senza isitshixo se-AES esingacwangciswanga ukufihla umbhalo, size sisongele eso sitshixo se-AES nge-RSA — ngoko umbhalo wayo nayiphi na ubude unokufihlwa. Ofumanayo ufuna isitshixo sangasese esihambelanayo ukuvula. Isitshixo sikawonke-wonke (SPKI) sinokwabelwana; isitshixo sangasese (PKCS#8) kufuneka sigcinwe siyimfihlo.
rsa-keys.status.ready: Silungile: chwetheza umbhalo wokufihla, okanye wamathisele umtya ofihliweyo ukuze uvule.
rsa-keys.status.pubOnly: Isitshixo sikawonke-wonke sikhona: unokufihla. Akukho sitshixo sangasese, ngoko akukwazi ukuvula okwangoku.

Ikofu yobisi ebandayo sisiselo esaziwayo kubantu behlabathi liphela. Rhoqo ekuseni, izigidi zabantu ziqala usuku lwazo ngeglasi yekofu yobisi ebandayo etyebileyo, ehlaziyayo.

Ukwenza ikofu yobisi ebandayo emnandi, ufuna ikofu ecolwe intsha, ubisi neqhwa elininzi. Ikofu iyaphekwa kancinci, ithonsi nethonsi, malunga nemizuzu emihlanu.

typing-test.texts: Rhoqo ekuseni ndivuka kwangoko ndibaleke ndijikeleze echibini. Umoya omtsha uyawucoca ingqondo yam undilungiselele usuku olutsha emsebenzini. Emva koko ndityela nentsapho yam, ndifunde amaphepha ambalwa encwadi ndize ndiqalise usuku lwam. Imikhwa emincinci ephindaphindwayo yonke imihla iyongeza utshintsho olukhulu ngokuhamba kwexesha.|ENingizimu Afrika inezimo ezahlukeneyo zomhlaba, ukusuka kunxweme olunelanga lweKapa ukuya kwiincopho ezineqhwa zeDrakensberg. Abakhenkethi banokuhlola iintaba zeKaroo, bonwabele umculo waseThekwini okanye bahambe kwiitrato ezixakekileyo zeJohannesburg. Ummandla ngamnye unobuni bawo.|Ukufunda ukuchwetheza ngokungajongi yinkunzi eluncedo kuye nabani na osebenza ngekhompyuter. Ukuba uyayiqhelanisa, awusadingi ukujonga ikhibhodi, isantya sakho siyanyuka yaye wenza iimpazamo ezimbalwa. Zilolonge cishe imizuzu elishumi elinesihlanu yonke imihla, ugxile kuqala ekuchanekeni uze unyuse isantya kancinci.
typing-test.howTo: WPM = amagama achanekileyo ngomzuzu (oonobumba abahlanu abachwetheze kakuhle babalwa njengegama eli-1). Izalathiso: 40 WPM kuhle, 60 WPM kukhawuleza, ngaphezu kwe-80 WPM kukhawuleza kakhulu.

cps-test.info: I-CPS (ukucofa ngomzuzwana) lixesha ocofa ngalo ngomzuzwana. Uninzi lwabantu lufikelela kwi-6–7 CPS; abadlali abaziqhelanisayo bangafikelela kwi-10–14 CPS. Amarekhodi akho agcinwa kwisixhobo sakho kuphela.

notepad.welcomeBody:
Bhala amanqaku akho apha. Utshintsho ngalunye lugcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo kweli sikhangeli.

Isiluleko: cinezela "Inqaku elitsha" ukongeza ngakumbi, sebenzisa ibhokisi yokukhangela ukuhluza, uze ukhuphele njenge-.txt xa kufuneka kwenye isixhobo.
notepad.open: Vula ifayile ye-.txt okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
notepad.privacy: Amanqaku agcinwa kuphela kweli sikhangeli nakweli sixhobo (akalungelelaniswa kwenye indawo). Ukucima idatha yokukhangela kuza kuwacima, ngoko khuphela amanqaku abalulekileyo.
notepad.full: Indawo yokugcina yesikhangeli igcwele. Khuphela uze ucime amanye amanqaku amadala.
notepad.tooBig: Ifayile inkulu kune-2 MB yaye ayikwazi ukuvulwa kwincwadana yamanqaku.

pdf-compress.dropTitle: Khetha ifayile ye-PDF okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
pdf-compress.dropHint: Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-200 MB. Ifayile ayiphumi kwisixhobo sakho.
pdf-compress.lLightD: imifanekiso ihlala phantse injengeyokuqala, ukunciphisa okuncinci
pdf-compress.lMediumD: imifanekiso ihlala icacile, ukunciphisa okukhulu; umbhalo awuchukunyiswa
pdf-compress.lExtremeD: iguqula iphepha ngalinye libe ngumfanekiso; incinci kakhulu, kodwa umbhalo awunakukhethwa okanye ukukopwa
pdf-compress.note: Ii-PDF ezingumbhalo ubukhulu (ezikhutshwe kwi-Word) zihlala zincinci ngaphambili yaye zincipha kancinci; ii-PDF ezinefoto ezininzi okanye ukuskena zincipha kakhulu. Ukuba isiphumo asincinci, zama Elomeleleyo okanye Eyona ngaphezulu.
pdf-compress.noImgs: Akukho mifanekiso ye-JPEG yokucinezela; ulwakhiwo lwefayile lulungisiwe.
pdf-compress.notSmaller: Ifayile ecinezelweyo ayincinci kunefayile yokuqala. Khetha inqanaba elomeleleyo ngakumbi, okanye le fayile sele ilungisiwe.

pdf-to-word.dropTitle: Khetha ifayile ye-PDF okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
pdf-to-word.dropHint: Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-100 MB namaphepha angama-300. Ifayile iqhutyelwa kwisixhobo sakho.
pdf-to-word.mTextD: iziqendu nezihloko ongazihlela; uyilo oluntsonkothileyo (iitafile, iikholam) lusenokutshintsha
pdf-to-word.mImageD: iphepha ngalinye liba ngumfanekiso kwi-Word, ofanayo nowokuqala kodwa ongahlelekiyo
pdf-to-word.mBothD: imifanekiso yamaphepha kunye nombhalo ongezantsi wokukopa

pdf-to-word.noText: Akukho mbhalo ufunyenwe kule fayile (isenokuba kukuskena). Khetha "Gcina uyilo lwephepha" okanye usebenzise isixhobo se-OCR.

word-to-pdf.dropTitle: Khetha ifayile ye-Word (.docx) okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
word-to-pdf.dropHint: Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-50 MB. Ifayile ifundwa kwisixhobo sakho, ayilayishwa.
word-to-pdf.note: "Khuphela i-PDF" yenza i-PDF ngoko nangoko (iphepha ngalinye ngumfanekiso wamgangatho ophezulu). "Prinda / Gcina i-PDF enombhalo ocacileyo" ivula ibhokisi yokuprinta: khetha iprinta ethi "Gcina njenge-PDF" ukufumana i-PDF enombhalo okhethwayo nokukhangelwayo. Uyilo oluntsonkothileyo (iintloko, iinyawo, iibhokisi zombhalo, iitshathi) lusenokwahluka kwelokuqala.
word-to-pdf.oldDoc: Iifayile ezindala ze-.doc (Word 97-2003) azikaxhasi. Yivule kwi-Word, uyigcine njenge-.docx, uze uzame kwakhona.
word-to-pdf.err: Ayikwazanga ukwenza i-PDF. Zama iqhosha elithi Prinda / Gcina i-PDF.
word-to-pdf.printTip: Khetha iprinta ethi "Gcina njenge-PDF" ukugcina ifayile.

pdf-sign.dropTitle: Khetha i-PDF yokusayina okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
pdf-sign.dropHint: Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-100 MB. Ifayile ayilayishwa.
pdf-sign.tip: Khetha ityikitye, uze ucofe kwiphepha ukulibeka. Rhola ukuhambisa, rhola isikwere ekoneni esezantsi ukutshintsha ubungakanani, cinezela × okanye Delete ukususa. Eli tyikitye lomfanekiso lilungele amaphepha emihla ngemihla; alithathi indawo yetyikitye ledijithali apho lifunekayo ngokomthetho.
pdf-sign.upHint: Ifoto yetyikitye lakho kwiphepha elimhlophe (JPG, PNG)
pdf-sign.emptySig: Akukho tyikitye okwangoku. Lizobe, chwetheza igama lakho okanye layisha umfanekiso.

pdf-edit.dropTitle: Khetha ifayile ye-PDF okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
pdf-edit.dropHint: Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-100 MB. Ifayile ayilayishwa.
pdf-edit.tip: Khetha isixhobo, uze ucofe kwiphepha ukusibeka. Cofa umbhalo ukuwuhlela, rhola ukuhambisa, rhola isikwere ekoneni esezantsi ukutshintsha ubungakanani, cinezela Delete ukususa. Qaphela: "Ibhokisi emnyama/Ukufihla ngomhlophe" ligubungela umxholo ngokubonakalayo kuphela; umbhalo wokuqala ungezantsi uhlala kwifayile. Ukususa ngokwenene ulwazi olubuthathaka, qhuba kwakhona Cinezela i-PDF kwinqanaba eliPhezulu kakhulu (iguqula amaphepha abe yimifanekiso).
pdf-edit.unicodeLocked: Iindawo ezinoonobumba abanemiqondiso okanye abangeyiyo i-Latin zibhalwe ngqo kwiphepha (ezo ndawo azisenakuhlelwa).

image-ocr.dropTitle: Khetha imifanekiso okanye i-PDF eskeniweyo, okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
image-ocr.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, PDF. Unokunamathisela ne-screenshot nge-Ctrl+V.
image-ocr.enhance: Bukhali umfanekiso phambi kokufunda (imifanekiso engacacanga, umbhalo omncinci)
image-ocr.outPh: Umbhalo ovela kumfanekiso wakho uya kuvela apha.
image-ocr.note: Ukwazisa kusebenza kwisikhangeli sakho; okokuqala kukhuphela injini kunye nedatha yolwimi (malunga ne-5–20 MB ulwimi ngalunye), ukusebenza okulandelayo kukhawuleza. Imifanekiso ecacileyo enombhalo oprintiweyo kwisiseko esikhanyayo isebenza kakuhle; umbhalo wesandla unzima ukuwazi.
image-ocr.max3: Khetha ubuninzi beelwimi ezi-3 ukuze ukwazisa kukhawule kuchane.
image-ocr.pdfLimit: Amaphepha okuqala angama-50 kuphela e-PDF angeziwe.
image-ocr.noText: Akukho mbhalo ufunyenwe. Zama umfanekiso ocacileyo ngakumbi, ulwimi olufanelekileyo, okanye vula ukubukhali.
image-ocr.errNet: Ayikwazanga ukukhuphela injini yokwazisa okanye idatha yolwimi. Khangela uqhagamshelo lwakho lwe-intanethi uzame kwakhona.

heic-jpg.dropTitle: Khetha iifoto ze-HEIC okanye uzirhole uziwise apha
heic-jpg.dropHint: Iifoto ze-.heic / .heif ezivela kwi-iPhone okanye i-iPad. Ezininzi ngexesha elinye, nganye engaphantsi kwe-50 MB.
heic-jpg.note: Iifoto ziguqulwa kwisixhobo sakho. Okokuqala, i-decoder ye-HEIC (malunga ne-1.5 MB) iyakhutshelwa. Kwii-Live Photos kugcinwa kuphela ifreyimu ephambili. Idatha yendawo ye-GPS evela kuqala ayiphethwa.
heic-jpg.notHeic: ayiyo ifoto ye-HEIC. Kwimifanekiso eqhelekileyo ye-JPG/PNG sebenzisa isixhobo Sokuguqula Ifomathi Yomfanekiso.
heic-jpg.errNet: Ayikwazanga ukukhuphela i-decoder. Khangela uqhagamshelo lwakho uzame kwakhona.
heic-jpg.errDecode: Ayikwazanga ukufunda le foto (ifayile ibonakele okanye uhlobo lwe-HEIC olungaxhaswanga).

image-upscale.dropTitle: Khetha umfanekiso okanye uwurhole uwuwise apha
image-upscale.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Iifoto ezincinci, ezingacacanga okanye ezindala zizuza kakhulu.
image-upscale.mX4c: isusa iziphene ze-JPEG, kwimifanekiso egcinwe kwiwebhu
image-upscale.note: I-AI isebenza kwisixhobo sakho; imifanekiso ayithunyelwa naphi na. Okokuqala ikhuphela imodeli ye-5–20 MB. Imifanekiso iqhutywa ngamacandelo amancinci, ngoko imifanekiso emikhulu isenokuthatha imizuzu embalwa; kucetyiswa i-Chrome okanye i-Edge entsha (ikhawuleza kakhulu nge-WebGPU).
image-upscale.shrunk: Umfanekiso mkhulu, ngoko unciphiswe wafikelela kwi
image-upscale.err: Ayikwazanga ukuqhuba i-AI kweli sikhangeli. Zama i-Chrome okanye i-Edge entsha.

video-compress.dropTitle: Khetha ividiyo okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
video-compress.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI. Ilungele engaphantsi kwe-300 MB (ubuninzi be-500 MB).
video-compress.note: Ividiyo icinezelwa kwisikhangeli sakho nge-ffmpeg yaye ayilayishwa. Okokuqala, iprosesa (malunga ne-31 MB) iyakhutshelwa. Ukucinezela kusebenza kwi-CPU, ngoko kucotha kunesoftiwe yekhompyuter: ividiyo yomzuzu o-1 ihlala ithatha imizuzu eyi-1–5. Gcina le thebhu ivuliwe kude kugqitywe.
video-compress.tooBig: Ividiyo inkulu kune-500 MB, ngaphezu kwento eyenziwa sisikhangeli. Yinqumle kuqala.
video-compress.errCode: I-ffmpeg ayikwazanga ukuqhuba le vidiyo (ifomathi engaqhelekanga okanye ifayile ebonakele).
video-compress.notSmaller: Ividiyo ecinezelweyo ayincinci (eyokuqala sele icinezelwe kakuhle). Khetha Elomeleleyo okanye isisombululo esiphantsi.

video-to-mp3.dropTitle: Khetha ividiyo okanye uyirhole uyiwise apha
video-to-mp3.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, FLV… Ukuya kuthi ga kwi-1 GB.
video-to-mp3.fade: Nyusa uze unciphise isandi (imizuzwana emi-2), kuhle kwiringtone
video-to-mp3.note: Iqhutywa kwisikhangeli sakho nge-ffmpeg; ividiyo ayilayishwa. Okokuqala, iprosesa (malunga ne-31 MB) iyakhutshelwa. Khupha isandi kuphela kwiividiyo ozilungelo lokuzisebenzisa.
video-to-mp3.tooBig: Ifayile inkulu kune-1 GB, ngaphezu kwento eyenziwa sisikhangeli.
video-to-mp3.badTime: Ixesha elingasebenziyo. Sebenzisa imizuzu:imizuzwana, umzekelo 1:30; isiphelo kufuneka sibe emva kokuqala.
video-to-mp3.noAudio: Ayikwazanga ukukhupha isandi. Ividiyo isenokuba ayinasandi okanye isebenzisa ifomathi engaxhaswanga.

web-desktop.emptyFolder: Le folda ayinanto. Rhuqela iifayile apha okanye ucofe Layisha.
web-desktop.noFolderDl: Akukakwazeki ukukhuphela ifolda iphela. Vula ifolda uze ukhuphele iifayile nganye nganye.
web-desktop.textTooBig: Le fayile inkulu ngaphezu kwe-5 MB, inkulu kakhulu kuNotepad. Yikhuphele uze uyivule kwi-app ekhompyutheni yakho.
web-desktop.imgFail: Lo mfanekiso awunakuboniswa. Wukhuphele uze uwuvule kwenye i-app.
web-desktop.pdfHint: Akukho nto ibonakalayo? Cofa "Vula kwithebhu entsha" okanye "Khuphela".
web-desktop.trashDriveNote: Izinto ezisemgqomeni zisasebenzisa indawo yeDrive de zicinywe ngokusisigxina.
web-desktop.emptyQ: Cima ngokusisigxina izinto ezi-{n} ezisemgqomeni? Oku akunakubuyiselwa.
web-desktop.wallHint: Ufuna ifoto yakho? Vula umfanekiso kwiifayile uze ucofe "Yenza umva wesikrini".
web-desktop.storedDrive: Igcina kwiGoogle Drive ka-{email}, kwifolda ethi WFTools/Desktop.
web-desktop.storedLocal: Igcina kwesi siphequluli, kwesi sixhobo. Ukucoca idatha yesiphequluli kuya kucima iifayile; ngena ngeGoogle ukuze ugcine kwiDrive.
web-desktop.gateTitle: Khetha apho uza kugcina khona iifayile zakho
web-desktop.gateBody: Ngena ngeGoogle kwaye yonke ifayile oyenza kwidesktop iya kugcinwa kwifolda ethi WFTools/Desktop kwiGoogle Drive yakho kwaye ivuleke kuso nasiphi na isixhobo. I-WFTools ibona kuphela iifayile ezenziwe yiyo. Okanye zama ngoku uze ugcine iifayile kwesi siphequluli kuphela.
web-desktop.reconnectBody: Iseshoni yakho yeGoogle iphelelwe lixesha. Cofa iqhosha elingezantsi ukuze uphinde uvule iifayile zakho.
web-desktop.pasteInside: Ifolda ayinakuncanyathiselwa ngaphakathi kwayo. Khetha enye ifolda.
